record_name: Duane Arnold Solar Projects I and II
excerpt: Stop Industrial-Scale Solar on Agricultural - Rural Land in Linn County, IA. Rural communities within Linn County including Center Point, IA, Palo, IA, and Toddville, IA are being threatened by industrial-scale solar projects. ... Tonight's meeting is the 1st of 3 meetings where the Linn County Board of Supervisors will consider and vote on the rezoning application for NextEra's Duane Arnold Solar project 1 and 2.
note: Opened 2026-11-19: change.org petition addressed to the Linn County Board of Supervisors, created April 18, 2021 by Sara Alden of Center Point. Its updates name NextEra's Duane Arnold Solar projects 1 and 2 and the supervisors' rezoning votes. The petition does not name Coggon Solar. Signature counts appear only in the organizer's own updates and are not recorded here.
